correctness.rationale: The twelve line coefficients lie in Eisenstein integers; all 220 triple determinants have norms in {0,1,3,9,27}. Since all nonzero norms are 3-powers, reduction modulo any p≠3 preserves the 36 triple concurrences, hence nine fourfold Hesse base points and 12 nodes. Each fourfold germ is unit-equivalent to f=v(u³+v³). Its intrinsic Tjurina quotient in p=2 is k[[u,v]]/(u³,u²v,v⁴), with nine monomial basis elements, Hilbert function 1,2,3,2,1 and socle dimension two (u²,uv³). For p≠2,3, invertibility of 4 and the Euler relation give the regular-sequence quotient (u²v,u³+4v³), length nine and socle one. Nodes each contribute one: 9×9+12=93, and local complete intersection holds precisely outside characteristic two in p≠3 family. This is the intrinsic scheme (F,Fx,Fy,Fz), not gradient-only in p=2.

value.rationale: The jump from a length-nine Gorenstein local complete intersection to a same-length same-Hilbert-function non-Gorenstein Artin ring is a sharp characteristic-dependent pathology for a canonical, highly symmetric line arrangement. It supplies a concrete algebraic-geometric boundary distinguishing Hilbert/length invariants from socle/Gorenstein behavior and clarifies why char-zero freeness criteria cannot be transferred blindly.
